title: Quick Crispy American Rice Pilaf
description: A crispy and flavorful one-pot American dish featuring Rice Krispies, cooked to perfection in a tagine pot, inspired by the stone-bowl-dolsot method, and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat the tagine pot over medium heat with 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the grated carrots and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the brown rice and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the crushed Rice Krispies, salt, black pepper, and fermented soy sauce.
Increase the heat to medium-high and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the Rice Krispies are crispy and golden brown.
